title-group.article-title: Long-read metagenomics reveals age-associated gut microbial genomes

sec.title: Materials and methods
sec.p: Samples were collected from adults. DNA was extracted and sequenced using PacBio HiFi. Reads were quality filtered and assembled with a long-read assembler.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Age-associated microbial genomes were recovered. The long-read workflow generated complete contigs and identified multi-omics associations.
